language.forced: Combwork was started in {language} (--lang): this setting applies from its next start.
language.restart: Combwork's own text has changed language. Chromium's parts (the PDF viewer, date pickers) follow when Combwork next starts.
language.setting.desc: The language Combwork shows. Automatic follows Windows' display languages.
language.setting.tip: Languages marked as translated by AI were drafted by agents, and improvements are welcome. Combwork speaks to agents and the Assistant in English whatever this says; they can still answer you in your language. Combwork started with --lang uses that language until it next starts.
language.setting.title: Language
